fullPassage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more sophisticated our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.

questions.passage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, __________ to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.

[조건] (1) more, our, security, sophisticated, the를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 5단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어 표현을 작성하는 문제이다.

the 비교급 구문에서 'the more sophisticated our security'가 된다.
det.tip: the more sophisticated = 더 정교한 (the 비교급 구문).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유목민 부족은 여행자에게 음식과 '환대(hospitality)'를 제공한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① hostility — 적대감. 집을 열고 음식을 주는 맥락과 정반대
✅ ② hospitality — 환대. 집을 열고 음식을 주는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ hesitation — 주저. 기꺼이(happy to share) 나누는 맥락과 부적절
❌ ④ hierarchy — 위계. 나눔의 맥락과 무관
det.tip: hospitality = 환대, 접대. food and hospitality = 음식과 환대.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많이 가지지 못하면서도 기꺼이 나누는 부족은 '유목민(nomadic)' 부족이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① notorious — 악명 높은. 부족 설명으로 문맥과 무관
❌ ② numerous — 다수의. 부족의 성격이 아닌 수량 형용사
❌ ③ nocturnal — 야행성의. 동물 묘사에 주로 사용, 부적절
✅ ④ nomadic — 유목의. 많이 갖지 못하면서 떠돌며 나눔을 실천하는 부족 ←정답
det.tip: nomadic tribes = 유목민 부족. 정착하지 않고 이동하며 생활하는 부족.

questions.passage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is (A)[complicated / simplified] when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their (B)[survival / destruction] depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more sophisticated our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our (C)[decreased / increased] physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 자원이 풍부할 때 나눔 본능은 '복잡해진다(complicated)'. (B) 나눔에 달린 것은 '생존(survival)'. (C) 물리적 교류는 '줄어든(decreased)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① complicated(복잡해진) — survival(생존) — decreased(줄어든): 자원 풍부 시 나눔 본능 복잡해지고, 생존이 나눔에 의존하며, 교류가 줄어든다 ←정답
❌ ② complicated(복잡해진) — destruction(파괴) — increased(증가한): (B) 파괴가 나눔에 달려 있다는 것은 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ③ simplified(단순해진) — survival(생존) — decreased(줄어든): (A) 자원 풍부 시 나눔이 단순해진다는 것은 본문과 반대
❌ ④ simplified(단순해진) — destruction(파괴) — increased(증가한): (A)(B)(C) 모두 본문과 반대
det.tip: (A) complicated = 복잡해진, (B) survival = 생존, (C) decreased = 줄어든

questions.passage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are ①<u>happy</u> to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and ②<u>shelter</u> another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more ③<u>primitive</u> our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a ④<u>disconnection</u> or blindness to reality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 더 많이 가질수록 보안이 '정교해진다(sophisticated)'는 맥락이므로 '원시적인(primitive)'은 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① happy — 기꺼이 나누는, 원문 일치
✅ ② shelter — 쉼터, 원문 일치
❌ ③ primitive → 원문은 sophisticated(정교한). 더 많이 가질수록 보안이 더 정교해진다는 맥락에서 원시적인(primitive)은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ disconnection — 단절, 원문 일치
det.tip: sophisticated(정교한) ↔ primitive(원시적인)
